title: Move to Dahlia
subtitle: Installs Dahlia Linux onto a free SSD and takes over the Unraid settings.
code.title: Access code
code.text: The code is in this container's log (in Unraid: Docker, the container's icon, "Logs").
take.title: What is taken over
take.none: No Unraid settings found. Dahlia is installed fresh.
take.disks: Disks: {data} data, {parity} parity, {cache} cache (by serial number)
take.shares: {n} shares with access rights and cache setting
take.users: SMB users, with password where one is set: {names}
take.containers: Docker containers as apps, with their app data: {names}
take.no_plugins: Plugins (most of it is built into Dahlia)
take.no_vms: VM settings (the disk files stay and can be attached as a Dahlia VM)
take.no_bond: Bonding, VLANs and bridges (main connection only)
take.parity: The parity: SnapRAID computes it once after the move, until then the data has no parity protection
disk.title: Disk for Dahlia
disk.text: Dahlia is installed onto this disk, everything on it is erased. Disks that Unraid uses are locked. An SSD of 20 GB or more is enough.
disk.confirm: This disk still holds data. Type its serial number to erase it: {serial}
set.title: Settings
set.account: Account name (for dashboard, terminal and SSH)
set.warning: Unraid keeps running meanwhile. Only when everything is done do you shut the server down.
step.system: Set up the system (account, network, kernel)
job.error: Error: {error}. Unraid and its disks are unchanged.
done.step1: Write the code down or take a photo of it.
done.step2: In Unraid, stop the array and shut the server down.
done.step3: Pull the Unraid flash drive and keep it safe, then start the server. It boots Dahlia from the SSD.
done.step4: In the Dahlia app or at https://dahlia.local/ (or the new server name), enter the code. Dahlia then offers to take over the Unraid disks, shares and containers.
done.back: Back to Unraid: plug the Unraid flash drive back in and boot from it in the BIOS. As long as Dahlia has not recomputed the parity, Unraid is unchanged.
error.hostname: Server name: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.
error.account: Account name: 2 to 32 lower-case letters, digits, _ or -, starting with a letter. System names are not allowed.
error.password: The password needs at least 10 characters.
error.confirm: The serial number does not match.
